quest.title: Tatara Tales: Functional Test
quest.description: Xavier, who is researching the Mikage Furnace, seems to have had some new idea...
quest.rewards_formatted: Adventure EXP x150, Primogem x20, Mora x25000

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Oh! Uh, Traveler... Things do not look good.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: The Fatui within have concentrated their forces near the core. It seems that they have discovered something.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Surely they don't intend to breach the core's defenses... No, we can no longer afford to delay. We must move now to initiate functionality tests.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Functionality tests?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: By that, I mean that we must test our machine friend's purification abilities. I have no intention of moving it into the furnace only to find that it will not function.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: To that end, please help me find 3 Onikabuto, if you will.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I want to place them near the Mikage Furnace, which will cause them to be tainted by Tatarigami.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Then, we will retrieve them, and use this purification device to cleanse them.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: This is the test I have devised.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Where do I find these Onikabuto?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Hmm... normally, they are found in Electro-rich environments...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I have also heard that they can survive near the Mikage Furnace. What hardy little critters they are...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Why don't I just snag some from in the furnace, then?

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Well, you could do that, but if you were to take Onikabuto directly from the Mikage Furnace for testing...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: To tell you the truth, I worry about the reliability of my little machine...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: It is best to work through tests step by step, after all.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Ahem, well then... please help me find 3 Onikabuto, if you will.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: So you do. Just 3 is fine!

choices.text: I could just take a dip inside the Furnace myself...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Well... you could use yourself as the test subject, yes.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: But like I said before, this device's reliability may not meet expectations.

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: If something unexpected truly does happen during the purification process, you might... uh, encounter some unforeseen issues...

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Ahem. Let's just stick to using the Onikabuto for now, shall we?

response.speaker: Xavier
response.text: Just 3 will do! Once you've caught them, just bring them back here.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Ah. How's it going? Have you caught those 3 Onikabuto?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: They're right here.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: That should do, then, yes. Thank you! I shall begin tests immediately.

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: Ah, my machine friend, let's hope that you do fine...

dialogues.speaker: Xavier
dialogues.text: I wonder if Inazuma did appointed a project manager for this whole Mikage Furnace business...
